name: Donchian-Chandelier FX Breakout
description: Trend-following breakout strategy on USD/JPY using 20-day Donchian Channels for long and short entries with a 2x ATR(14) chandelier trailing stop. Enters long on close above prior bar's 20-day high, enters short on close below prior bar's 20-day low. Uses 100% capital allocation per trade.
source:
# Donchian-Chandelier FX Breakout — USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# Trend-following breakout strategy on USD/JPY using 20-day Donchian Channels
# with a 2× ATR(14) chandelier trailing stop.
#
# RULES:
# - Long Entry:  Close > Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Upper Band
# - Short Entry: Close < Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Lower Band
# - Exit (Shield): Trailing stop at 2 × ATR(14) from extreme
# - Sizing: 100% of capital per trade (percent-based)
# - Long AND short — flips direction on opposing breakout
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 20-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 20 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=20)(src.h, src.l)
upper_band = donchian.bbands_upper
lower_band = donchian.bbands_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 14-Day ATR for volatility measurement
atr14 = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)

# Stop distance = 2 × ATR(14)
stop_dist = 2 * atr14

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# LONG ENTRY: Close breaks above prior bar's 20-day high
long_breakout = close > upper_band_prior

# SHORT ENTRY: Close breaks below prior bar's 20-day low
short_breakout = close < lower_band_prior

# Hold long from upper breakout until lower breakout flips us short
long_state = hold_until()(enter=long_breakout, exit=short_breakout)

# Hold short from lower breakout until upper breakout flips us long
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_breakout, exit=long_breakout)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long and short zones — flips direction on opposing breakout
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# Simple 100% capital allocation per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# Chandelier trailing stop at 2 × ATR(14)
# For longs: trails from highest high; for shorts: trails from lowest low
trailing_stop()(distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark long breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Breakout",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Upper Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_band_prior, atr14, long_breakout)

# Mark short breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Breakout",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Lower Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_band_prior, atr14, short_breakout)
